in_marathi.name: Bhardwaj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Son of Bhrada
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhardwaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Originally a surname derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Bhrad’ meaning ‘extensive’ and ‘waj’ meaning ‘vehicle’ or ‘control’. The name Bhardwaj is believed to be the title given to the descendants of sage Ved Vyas who wrote the Mahabharata and the Puranas. This name is symbolic of being an embodiment of knowledge and wisdom.
